draft.subject: basecamp accounts payable
draft.body: Basecamp has reached an estimated $280M in ARR as a bootstrapped business. As transaction volumes grow rapidly through this scaling phase, finance operations face mounting pressure to handle increased workloads without adding proportional headcount. An AI employee takes the repetitive accounts payable queue, so the team's own people can work on the exceptions. Worth a look?
